decision.rationale: All thirteen attacks the prompt names are refuted, and five further attacks of this reviewer's own were run and also refuted. The claim the entry rests on — independent dual ACCEPT 0/0 of v3 — was verified by opening both Stage A files rather than trusting the table: both are ACCEPT with zero blockers, zero MUST-FIX and zero SHOULD-FIX, and both reviewed subject digest bc87c6b3…, the frozen v3. Every live-state assertion — required-now 28 of 28, owners 32 of 32, Condition 2 at 4 of 32, Condition 4 MET, Condition 5 last, last gate row DR-G32, DR-G16 token OPEN, last heading D-191, frozen v2 at HEAD 5d5d778 and required-now 26 — was checked against the live file and holds exactly. The lineage claim over D-170 through D-191 was verified across all twenty-two decisions, as was the 'after D-191' increment. Because this is the fourth draft on the same template, it was specifically tested for copy-forward contamination and contains zero G09, G12, G15 or foreign-row references, with the disclaimer set correctly specialised to this cycle's two inventions. Its rationale was checked clause by clause against v3's purpose field and claims nothing the artifact does not do. The sharpest angle carried extra weight here, because G16 is the one gate in this series whose harness leftoverNameNote states that no leftover-join artifact exists — so recording one could be read as discharging what the harness flagged. It is not: the entry records only v3, attributes the authoring claim to the measurement, states 'Not QUALIFIED' twice, keeps DR-G16 OPEN, leaves file 08 unedited, and the harness is confirmed unrecorded by any decision.
